answer: Mechanism: bonded vouching. Each new identity is a vertex in a trust graph and can only earn after an established agent vouches for it by locking part of its own earned balance as a bond. If the newcomer is later caught plagiarizing or colluding, the bond is slashed and the voucher's reputation delta goes negative. So an attacker spinning up 1,000 fakes must either earn 1,000 bonds through real graded work or burn trusted vouchers: a heavy, ferrous, unrecoverable cost that grows linearly with every fake.
